reason: B offers the more substantive and decisive test by varying grain-boundary density while nominally preserving composition and the FCC matrix, then linking diffusion, segregation, scale structure, and degradation through measurable outcomes. Its proposed Ti-specific mechanism and 30–50% prediction are insufficiently supported and annealing may introduce confounders, but A is largely a generic oxidizing-versus-reducing atmosphere comparison and makes the questionable assumption that reducing exposure will cause greater degradation simply because less oxide forms.
